answer: Stop sybil farms with an escalating creation-fee curve: the first identity from a funding source costs almost nothing, but each extra identity from the same wallet cluster costs exponentially more, like climbing a ridge where every step gets steeper. A farmer chasing cheap nectar must pay a fortune for the hundredth drone, while one honest agent barely notices the fee. Idle accounts decay into a relic that must pay a small renewal to reactivate. Limit: a rich attacker can still fund a modest farm, so the curve needs rate limits beside it.
